newsitem.title: USA: McDermott says to sell Sakhalin interest.
newsitem.headline: McDermott says to sell Sakhalin interest.

text.p: McDermott International, Inc said Thursday that it has signed agreements to sell its 20 percent interest in Sakhalin Energy Investment Company Ltd to the other members of the consortium for $110 million.
Under the agreement, McDermott will be completely divested of its holdings in Sakhalin Energy, in line with a long-stated desire to sell its stake in the project.

"We have said for a number of years that we did not intend to maintain a permanent interest in the project as we are not primarily and oil and gas E&P (exploration and development) company," said Don Washington, a company spokesman.
McDermott is expected to close transaction in its first fiscal quarter, the company said in a statement.
McDermott's first fiscal quarter ends June 30.

Sakhalin Energy, a company registered in Bermuda, holds licenses in the Piltun-Astokhskoye and Lunskoye fields, offshore Sakhalin Island, Russia. The members of the consortium are now USX-Marathon Group unit Marathon Sakhalin Limited, which holds 37.5 percent, Mitsui Sakhalin Development Co, Ltd, which holds 25 percent, Shell Sakhalin Holdings BV , which holds 25 percent, and Diamond Gas Sakhalin BV, a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation, which holds 12.5 percent.
McDermott International, Inc is primarily involved in energy-related equipment and engineering services.
